caption: Getting started
vo: New to Genesis CRM? Give us a few minutes, and you'll know your way around before you open a single module.

caption: Sign in as Priya Ramdin — Relationship Manager
vo: We'll sign in as Priya Ramdin, a relationship manager. She looks after her own book of clients and enquiries.

caption: Your home page opens on the dashboard for your role
vo: Notice where she lands. Relationship managers start on My Workbench.

caption: At the top: the Service Levels radiator
vo: Up top is the Service Levels radiator. What's breached, what's at risk, what's on track. Click any one to open it.

caption: Below it: My Workbench — open enquiries, next-best actions, reviews and KYC
vo: Below that, her workbench. Open enquiries, next-best actions, reviews and KYC. And every number only counts records Priya is allowed to see.

caption: Switch to any other dashboard you may see from this menu
vo: Need a different view? This menu switches to any other dashboard you can see, like Lead Funnel or Lending Pipeline.

caption: The sidebar groups the modules by business area
vo: Now the sidebar. It groups the modules by business area, from Tools and Documents, through Client 360, Lending and Investments, all the way down to Compliance and Masters.

caption: You only see the modules your role is allowed to use
vo: You only see the modules your role allows. As an RM, Priya gets client, lending, investment and service modules, but not the advisory deal room.

caption: Search finds clients, enquiries, applications and more
vo: Looking for something? Global search finds clients, enquiries, applications and more, by name, number, email or phone.

caption: Pick a result to open it
vo: Priya's looking for Deepak Seegoolam. The client record comes first, so she picks it.

caption: Open a module, then pick an object from the tabs at the top
vo: To work in a module, open it, then pick an object from the tabs. Here, Enquiries.

caption: The Table view: sort by a column, filter, search, select rows for bulk actions
vo: The Table view is the familiar one. Sort, filter, search, select rows for bulk actions, and export what you see to a CSV.

caption: The Pipeline view: a Kanban board with one column per stage
vo: Prefer a board? The Pipeline view has one column per stage. Drag a card to move it, though a gate may ask for missing details first.

caption: Click a record to open its panel
vo: Click a record and its panel opens. Header and actions at the top, grouped fields, then tabs.

caption: Calculated fields are greyed and update by themselves
vo: See the greyed fields? They're calculated. Lead score, grade, indicative rate and instalment all update by themselves.

caption: Related: every record linked to this one
vo: The Related tab gathers everything linked to this record. On a client, that's applications, KYC cases, mandates, holdings and requests.

caption: Activity: calls, meetings, emails and notes
vo: Activity holds the calls, meetings, emails and notes. Log your own right here.

caption: Tasks: follow-ups with an owner, due date and priority
vo: Tasks are follow-ups with an owner, a due date and a priority. Overdue ones land on your workbench.

caption: Docs: documents, the document checklist, upload, share and e-signature
vo: Docs holds the documents and the checklist, with upload, share and e-signature. You can even send the client a secure upload link.

caption: Audit: who changed what and when
vo: And Audit tells you who changed what, and when.

caption: Add a follow-up task on the record
vo: Let's add a follow-up. On the Tasks tab, Priya creates a task to call the client and confirm the documents.

caption: The task is saved on the record and appears on your workbench
vo: Saved, and it's on her workbench too.

caption: The bell shows new assignments, approvals waiting for you and SLA warnings
vo: The bell is where new assignments, approvals waiting for you and SLA warnings show up. Click one to jump straight there.

caption: Approvals: credit decisions, KYC sign-off and maker-checker steps wait here
vo: Approvals are where credit decisions, KYC sign-off and maker-checker steps wait. And whoever asked can never approve their own request.

caption: My Reminders: personal nudges you can snooze or complete
vo: My Reminders holds your personal nudges. Snooze them, or tick them off.

caption: Personalise: light or dark mode, text size and motion
vo: Let's make it yours. The palette icon in the header lets you choose light or dark mode, the text size and the amount of motion.

caption: EN | FR switches module, field, stage and picklist names to French
vo: Working with French-speaking clients? One click on the language switch, and module, field, stage and picklist names all change to French. One more click, and you're back in English.

caption: Sign out from the header when you are done
vo: When you're done, sign out from the header. Your avatar menu also covers password, two-factor authentication and your calendar feed.

caption: Pick a module tutorial
vo: That's the tour. Sign in, search, open records, and you're ready. Now pick a module, each one has its own video.
